links.outcome: LLM-generated clinical summaries versus human clinician-written summaries, rated on clinical criteria
links.effect: Human summaries scored highest for factual consistency (3.75) and usefulness (3.63); TH-VAE 3.35 and 3.28; 2-step LLM models comparable to humans on interpersonal/intrapersonal patterns and changes over time.
links.quote: Human summaries scored highest for factual consistency (3.75) and general usefulness (3.63).

unlisted_practices: Multistep versus single-step LLM prompting for clinical summarization of social media timelines
Hierarchical VAE plus LLM pipeline for summarizing long patient timelines
Linguistic diversity as a proxy for personalization of LLM summaries

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM and VAE pipeline capability to summarize social media timelines for mental health monitoring against human clinician summaries.
